title: Case: Tracking says delivered but the recipient has no parcel
context: The system displays delivery, but the verified recipient reports no receipt. Registration of an investigation is the task outcome, not a finding of loss or fraud.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-024: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. 34 irrelevant events turn this into a long thread; the decisive events are the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
